quizName: Hardest Questions in Oregon Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Motorcycle riders should choose footwear with soles that:
questions.explanation: Wear high, sturdy boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles. The soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: When should you use a turn signal?

options.text: When you plan to speed up.
Only when there is heavy traffic.

questions.explanation: Use a turn signal every time you turn or change lanes, even if you think no one is watching.

questions.question: Where should you get information about your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Your owner's manual is the best source for information about your specific motorcycle. It includes details about how it works, its features, and maintenance.

questions.question: Which of these is a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: Slippery surfaces include wet pavement, loose gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lane markings, and metal covers in the road. Ride carefully on these surfaces.

questions.question: For the best protection, boots or shoes should:

options.text: Cover your ankle and provide support.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover your ankle and provide support.
questions.explanation: Wear high, sturdy boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles. Use low heels so they don't catch on the bike. Tuck in long laces so they don't get caught in the motorcycle.

questions.question: Should you use a turn signal if it is obvious you are turning?
questions.explanation: Always use a turn signal when you turn or change lanes, even if you think it's obvious. Other vehicles may be near you that you cannot see.

questions.question: Keeping space between your motorcycle and other vehicles allows you to:

options.text: React if another driver makes a mistake.
Stay in one spot in the lane with no movement options.
Depend on others to find hazards.
Go faster to keep up with traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: React if another driver makes a mistake.
questions.explanation: Space around your motorcycle gives you time and room to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: What happens when you take corners too fast?

options.text: You may slide into another lane.
It is better than going too slowly.
You will stay in your lane.
It is okay because motorcycles are small.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may slide into another lane.
questions.explanation: Taking a corner too fast can make you cross into another lane or leave the road. Slow down before turning.

questions.question: What is the most important thing you can do to survive a crash?

options.text: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.
questions.explanation: Wearing a high-quality helmet that is fastened securely is the most effective way to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: What should you do if a friend wants to ride their motorcycle after drinking too much?

options.text: Tell them to use empty roads.

questions.explanation: Never allow someone to ride if they have had too much to drink. Take their keys if necessary. Help them find another way to get home.

questions.question: What is a danger of riding next to parked cars?

options.text: You may not find a parking spot.
A driver may suddenly pull out into your path.
Other drivers may go slowly while looking for parking.
The road surface may be uneven.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver may suddenly pull out into your path.
questions.explanation: Riding next to parked cars is dangerous. A driver may pull out without looking. Car doors may open into your lane. Pedestrians may step out from between cars.

questions.question: What removes alcohol from your body?
questions.explanation: Only time reduces your blood alcohol level. Coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers cannot lower your blood alcohol level or make you sober. They may help you stay awake, but they do not change your blood alcohol level.

questions.question: What should a motorcyclist watch for ahead on the road?
questions.explanation: Watch the road ahead for changing traffic, hazards, and escape routes. Be ready to react to any changes.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while riding?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up.

questions.explanation: Do not ride if you are tired. On long trips, take a rest break every two hours to avoid fatigue.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT protective clothing for a motorcyclist?
questions.explanation: Wear protective clothing when riding. This includes sturdy jackets that cover your arms and legs, boots that cover and support your ankles, and sturdy gloves.

questions.question: How can you reduce head and neck injuries?
questions.explanation: A good helmet greatly reduces head and neck injuries. It is your best protection in a crash.

questions.question: What should you do to avoid accidents?

options.text: Blend in with traffic and avoid being noticed.
Use turn signals only at night.
Use turn signals when changing lanes and turning.
Ride close to the vehicle ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use turn signals when changing lanes and turning.
questions.explanation: Be visible to other drivers. Use turn signals, brake lights, and good lane position. Keep space between you and other vehicles. Look ahead for hazards and be ready to react.

questions.question: If you cannot avoid a slippery surface, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up and lean the motorcycle.
Speed up and keep the motorcycle upright.
Slow down and lean the motorcycle.
Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.
questions.explanation: If you cannot avoid a slippery surface, keep your motorcycle upright and go slowly.

questions.question: If your boots have laces, what should you do with them?
questions.explanation: Tuck in boot laces so they do not catch on your motorcycle.

questions.question: When does a motorcycle fit you properly?

options.text: When you can touch your feet to the ground while seated.
When you can reach the controls by stretching.
When the handlebars go over your head.
When your feet cannot rest on the foot pegs.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can touch your feet to the ground while seated.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits you properly when your feet can touch the ground while seated. You should be able to easily reach and operate all controls.

questions.question: Mirror checks should:

options.text: Only be done on long trips.
Be part of your normal routine while driving.
Not be done since you cannot change what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be part of your normal routine while driving.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of normal driving. Also check mirrors before changing lanes, when stopping at lights, and before slowing down.

questions.question: Which item does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: To stay safe, wear a DOT-approved helmet, eye protection, a strong jacket and long pants, high sturdy boots that support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: Your body removes alcohol only through:
questions.explanation: Only time lets your body remove alcohol. Nothing else speeds up this process. There are no shortcuts to becoming sober.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the most protection to motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants offer the best protection when riding a motorcycle.

questions.question: Motorcycle riding gloves are usually:
questions.explanation: Motorcycle gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.
